verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an accelerator, since some competing accelerators are cloud-only. AMD documents a complete operator-run stack for its own infrastructure: the open-source ROCm runtime and libraries, AMD SMI management, a Kubernetes GPU Operator, a container toolkit, a Slurm-compatible Spur scheduler, and cluster and system validation suites. Self-hosted inference via vLLM and SGLang is also documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of on-prem purchase and availability (community items only discuss cloud rental pricing), and independent hands-on reports of self-hosted deployments.
